prank_description: Hector swapped Kaio's scout compass with one slightly recalibrated by the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear.
summary: enclave_01_hector set up a prank intended for enclave_05_kaio, but enclave_05_kaio completely missed it, leaving enclave_13_ryn mildly inconvenienced and annoyed at enclave_01_hector.
science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea
narrative_prose: The exterior vista was battered by the churning ferrofluid sea, an aggressive expanse of iron-rich waves constantly attempting to CONSUME the rocky shore. High overhead, violent winds howled, their force amplified by the magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear that threatened to peel the protective plating from the colony's structures. Hector stood firm in the gale, having to DEFEND his footing against the sudden, sheer gusts of magnetic pressure. The dense mist served well enough to CONCEAL the slight adjustments he made to the brass scout compass in his hand. With a grin, Hector tapped the casing one last time before extending his arm, firmly pressing the recalibrated compass directly into Kaio's waiting hand for the next sweep.

horizon_goals.mid_term_milestone: Map the ferrofluid sea's expanding coastline.
horizon_goals.campaign_arc_climax: Integrate magnetic shielding with the core systems.

active_location.macro_silhouette: A sweeping, chaotic landscape defined by churning dark waves against jagged iron-stone cliffs.

sensory_palette.sight_and_color: Dark, oily blacks punctuated by brilliant, sparking orange lightning across the shear.
sensory_palette.sound: A deafening roar of wind overlapping with the heavy, sloshing impact of the ferrofluid sea.
sensory_palette.smell: Intense metallic tang overlaid with a sharp ozone freshness.
sensory_palette.tactile_temperature: A freezing, biting chill that penetrates heavy canvas coats instantly.
sensory_palette.taste_optional: The static bite of heavily ionized air.

interactive_features.affordance_description: Massive waves crashing with intense magnetic force, threatening to drag anything loose.
Large iron-rich stones that offer temporary shelter from the sheer winds.
Thick, localized fog banks that drastically reduce visibility.

reactive_toys.consistent_method: Generating erratic magnetic fields and sudden wind spikes.
reactive_toys.immediate_complication: Causes the modified compass to spin wildly.
reactive_toys.uninterrupted_escalation: Eventual complete loss of navigation and disorientation in the Wilds.

three_levels_of_why.level_1_immediate: Hector wants to pull a harmless prank on Kaio by slightly misaligning the compass.
three_levels_of_why.level_2_local: The local Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear is strong enough to make the prank plausible.
three_levels_of_why.level_3_campaign_arc: Testing navigation instruments under extreme planetary stress.

judge_tactician.failure_stakes_declared: The compass modification fails and it just breaks, requiring a trip to the Forge.

graduated_outcomes.nat_1_false_intuition: Hector permanently breaks the delicate compass needle.
graduated_outcomes.below_dc_complicated_fail_forward: The compass holds, but Hector's adjustment leaves it stuck pointing strictly North.
graduated_outcomes.meets_dc_clean_success: The compass now spins with a slight, humorous bias toward the ferrofluid waves.
graduated_outcomes.dc_plus_5_or_20_extended_lore: Hector accidentally calibrates the compass to perfectly track the moving shear waves.

master_narrator.agency_handoff_prompt: Hector securely places the modified brass compass into Kaio's waiting hand, signaling the start of the sweep.
